topics.title: Unstable Narratives and Erratic Behavior
topics.summary: A man recounts his father’s unpredictable behavior including falling asleep at school meetings, drug use, unusual clothing choices, and outbursts. The conversation shifts between concern for the children's well-being and observations of the father’s instability, touching on inappropriate situations involving young girls.

topics.title: Discussion of Ozzy Osbourne’s Finances
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss estimates of rock star Ozzy Osbourne's wealth including touring revenue and publishing rights, speculating on investments made by his wife while referencing a $3500 death pool game if he dies. They also explore potential investment values.

topics.title: Ozzy and the Naked Girls Phone-In
topics.summary: A chaotic phone-in segment erupts when callers debate whether it’s illegal for women to be in bra and panties near Ozzy Osbourne’s children, leading to absurd arguments about legality and inappropriate behavior. The conversation quickly devolves into personal comments regarding a caller's appearance.

topics.title: Family Music Preferences
topics.summary: A man recounts his family’s eccentric behavior including a $15,000 purchase to see the band Hanson and deliberate actions intended to irritate him, such as listening to radio DJs and refusing physical affection.

topics.title: Financial Discussion and Anecdote
topics.summary: During a conversation between Howard Stern and Ozzy Osbourne, they discuss Ozzy’s wealth and spending habits, including an estimated value of $150 million.  Ozzy then recounts an incident at the Beverly Hills Hotel involving expensive blouses, credit cards, and attempting to resolve charges with his wife.

topics.title: Therapy and Hollywood Aspirations
topics.summary: A man discusses his wife’s psychotherapy sessions and his daughters’ ambitions to pursue acting careers, including potential movie roles for himself and their plans for a tour with an independent bus.
